versions.subject: Rule: Suspicious Program Location Process Starts
versions.detection:
selection:
    EventID: 1
    Image: 
        # - '*\ProgramData\*'  # too many false positives, e.g. with Webex for Windows
        - '*\$Recycle.bin'
        - '*\Users\Public\*'
        - 'C:\Perflogs\*'
        - '*\Windows\Fonts\*'
        - '*\Windows\IME\*'
        - '*\Windows\addins\*'
        - '*\Windows\debug\*'
condition: selection

versions.subject: Escaped '\*' to '\\*' where required
versions.detection:
selection:
    EventID: 1
    Image: 
        # - '*\ProgramData\\*'  # too many false positives, e.g. with Webex for Windows
        - '*\$Recycle.bin'
        - '*\Users\Public\\*'
        - 'C:\Perflogs\\*'
        - '*\Windows\Fonts\\*'
        - '*\Windows\IME\\*'
        - '*\Windows\addins\\*'
        - '*\Windows\debug\\*'
condition: selection
